citations.title: Iberdrola posts 12% increase in net profit boosted by networks business

sentences.text: Iberdrola's 2025-2028 plan concentrates EUR 58 billion of investment, of which about EUR 37 billion goes to electricity networks and EUR 21 billion to renewables and customers, lifting the regulated asset base roughly 40% to EUR 70 billion by 2028.

sentences.quote: el plan se centra en el Reino Unido y Estados Unidos , que absorberan aproximadamente el 70% de la inversion , con una rentabilidad nominal media sobre el capital ( ROE ) de alrededor del 9,5% en los nuevos proyectos.
sentences.text: Capital is steered to low-risk jurisdictions, with the UK and US taking about 70% of network spending at around 9.5% nominal ROE and 85% of total investment in A-rated countries.
2025 net profit rose 12% to EUR 6.29 billion, driven by regulated networks in the UK and the United States, with the regulated asset base up 12% to almost EUR 51 billion.

sentences.quote: The company targets an adjusted net profit - which excludes one-offs - of more than 6.6 billion euros this year and more than 7.6 billion euros by 2028.
sentences.text: Management targets adjusted net profit above EUR 6.6 billion in 2026 and above EUR 7.6 billion by 2028.
Around EUR 20 billion is earmarked for dividends between 2024 and 2028.
